title: ChatGPT is Apple’s most downloaded app of 2025 in the US
description: This is ChatGPT's first year as the No. 1 app on the U.S. App Store by downloads.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Google launches managed MCP servers that let AI agents simply plug into its tools
description: Google is rolling out managed MCP servers to make its services “agent-ready by design,” starting with Maps and BigQuery, aiming to simplify messy integrations and help AI agents use real tools.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Hinge’s new AI feature helps daters move beyond boring small talk
description: Hinge launched “Convo Starters,” a feature powered by AI that provides personalized tips for initiating meaningful conversations.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: OpenAI boasts enterprise win days after internal ‘code red’ on Google threat
description: ChatGPT Enterprise usage grew 8x year-over-year as workers report saving an hour daily, but OpenAI faces competitive pressure from Anthropic and questions about cost sustainability.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI says it’s turned off app suggestions that look like ads
description: While OpenAI continues to insist that there are currently no ads — or tests for advertising — live in ChatGPT, the company’s chief research officer also acknowledged that the company “fell short” with recent promotional messages.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Pat Gelsinger wants to save Moore’s Law, with a little help from the Feds
description: The company is aiming to produce its first silicon wafers by 2028 and have its first commercial system online by 2029.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Ex-Googler’s Yoodli triples valuation to $300M+ with AI built to assist, not replace, people
description: Yoodli counts Google, Snowflake, and Databricks among its customers.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Sources: AI synthetic research startup Aaru raised a Series A at a $1B ‘headline’ valuation
description: The one-year-old startup, which does market research on simulated populations, had a multi-tier valuation round, sources tell TechCrunch.
author: Marina Temkin

title: AWS needs you to believe in AI agents
description: AWS announced a wave of new AI agent tools at re:Invent 2025, but can Amazon actually catch up to the AI leaders? While the cloud giant is betting big on enterprise AI with its third-gen chip and database discounts that got developers cheering, it’s still fighting to prove it can compete beyond infrastructure.  This week […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: Meta acquires AI device startup Limitless
description: Limitless said it shares Meta's vision of bringing personal superintelligence to everyone.
author: Sarah Perez

title: ChatGPT’s user growth has slowed, report finds
description: ChatGPT's global monthly active users only grew by around 5% from August to November, while Gemini's users grew by about 30%.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Nothing wants your money, AWS wants your trust, and Spotify wants your data
description: AWS announced a wave of new AI agent tools at re:Invent 2025, but can Amazon actually catch up to the AI leaders? While the cloud giant is betting big on enterprise AI with its third-gen chip and database discounts that got developers cheering, it’s still fighting to prove it can compete beyond infrastructure.  This week […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha, Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane

title: AWS re:Invent was an all-in pitch for AI. Customers might not be ready.
description: AWS is releasing a lot of new AI tech, but the cloud infrastructure giant's enterprise customers may not be ready for it yet.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: The New York Times is suing Perplexity for copyright infringement
description: The New York Times filed a copyright lawsuit against Perplexity, joining other publishers using legal action as leverage to force AI companies into licensing deals that compensate content creators.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Meta signs commercial AI data agreements with publishers to offer real-time news on Meta AI
description: Meta is partnering with CNN, Fox News, Fox Sports, Le Monde Group, the People Inc. portfolio of media brands, The Daily Caller, The Washington Examiner, and USA Today.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Chicago Tribune sues Perplexity
description: The newspaper is alleging copyright infringement and calling out Perplexity's retrieval augmented generation (RAG) as a culprit.
author: Julie Bort

title: All the biggest news from AWS’ big tech show re:Invent 2025
description: Amazon Web Services' giant tech conference re:Invent 2025 is happening this week with news ranging from chips to AI services.
author: Kirsten Korosec, Julie Bort, Rebecca Szkutak

title: Micro1, a Scale AI competitor, touts crossing $100M ARR
description: Micro1 started the year with roughly $7 million ARR. Now, it claims to have surpassed $100 million in ARR, double what it reported in September.
author: Tage Kene-Okafor
